note: Dorothea Keller: _Gattung und Stil in der Vulgata des Hieronymus. Untersuchungen zur hieronymianischen Bibelübersetzung am Beispiel hebräischer Wiederholungsfiguren_. Vertumnus 14. Göttingen 2022 (256 pp.), pp. 151–153 and 163–164.

A free translation or rather paraphrase in which Jerome introduces the word _stuprum_ – adultery (v. 10) that has no basis in the Hebrew text. The Nova Vulgata keep’s Jerome’s _ille recusabat stuprum_ – he refused the (act of) adultery. Also note Jerome’s use of _ille_ as a personal pronoun meaning “he.” – Albert Condamin SJ: Les caractères de la traduction de la Bible de saint Jérôme. _Recherches de science religieuse_ 3 (1912) 105–138, at pp. 107–108.

_nimium credulus verbis coniugis_ – giving too much credit to his wife’s words (Douay Version). This is not in the Hebrew, but represents an explicative addition by Jerome. The Nova Vulgata omits the words.
